TEST_QUESTIONS.question: According to the document, what should a student who forgot their ID do if they need to use the library?
TEST_QUESTIONS.expected_answer: The library enforces a no ID, no entry policy. A student without their ID may get a temporary ID permit from the Student Development Office (SDO).
TEST_QUESTIONS.source_document: CONSOLIDATED FAQs for VLA - Basic information.pdf

evidence.passage: For security purposes, the library enforces the "no ID, no entry" policy. Students who do not have their IDs and need to use the library may get a temporary ID permit from the Student Development Office (SDO).
